rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi/compound adjective qualifying śaktayaḥ; vaśya (subdued) + pratīti (cognition) + janikāḥ (producing)
śaktayaḥ (powers) + ca (and); sandhi fused in token
instrumental used adverbially to indicate order
relative pronoun referring to śaktayaḥ, linking to preceding description

items.question: Which powers, arising in sequence, produce the cognition of subjugation?
premises: The two instruments are characterized as consisting of attachment and aversion.
Certain powers arise in sequence from these instruments.
These powers produce the cognition of subjugation.
items.inference: The sequential powers associated with attachment and aversion generate the experience of subjugation.
uncertainties: The exact number and specific identities of the sequential powers are not stated in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: And which powers, arising in sequence, produce the cognition of being brought under control.
